title: This Cape Cod inn is one of the most haunted stays in America
excerpt: This week in Scenic Six, a haunted inn, a ski resort expansion, and 10 ways to enjoy Boston in New England for free.

Welcome back to Scenic Six.

We visited my son in Rhode Island over the weekend and dined in Providence’s historic Federal Hill. It was a gorgeous fall night, so we ate outside on the bustling DePasquale Plaza beneath the twinkling lights. What a treat. 

Speaking of treats, Happy Halloween week! If you are going to Salem, here’s everything you need to know. I’m also sharing info about a haunted hotel on the Cape, an expansion at a ski destination in the White Mountains, the Nantucket Christmas Stroll, free events in Boston, and more. 

One of the most haunted stays in America is on the Cape

Orleans Waterfront Inn, a restored 1875 sea captain’s home in Orleans on Cape Cod, was recently named among the most haunted hotels in America by Frommer’s, which says a spirit there named Hannah once lived and worked at the inn. Find out more about the stay and its spooky stories. 

10 free things to do in Boston in November

With the holidays around the corner, your wallet will thank you for attending these 10 free things to do in Boston in November. The activities range from coffee classes to concerts to Christmas tree lightings. 

King Pine Ski Resort in New Hampshire is expanding

King Pine Ski Resort in Madison, known for its family-friendly atmosphere and  affordability, is getting a new base lodge, expanded trails, an updated restaurant, and family après-ski programming. Find out more about the expansion plans. 

Travel tips

  • Give thanks this year at America’s Hometown Thanksgiving Celebration in Plymouth on Nov. 21. The iconic Thanksgiving parade draws more than 150,000 people.
  • The 54th annual Nantucket Christmas Stroll will take place Dec. 4-6 and include a European-style marketplace, Victorian carolers, more than 150 decorated trees, and a visit from Santa. 
  • A new, $121 million train station just opened in Windsor Locks, Conn. and serves CTrail trains, as well as Amtrak’s Hartford Line, Northeast Regional, Valley Flyer, and Vermonter routes.

Deals and steals

Note: Scenic Six arrives in inboxes Tuesdays at noon. If these deals are reaching you too late, sign up now to be the first in the know.

  • Enjoy early-bird pricing through Oct. 31 for Strawbery Banke Museum’s annual Candlelight Stroll in Portsmouth, N.H., taking place weekends Dec. 4-20 and featuring horse-drawn carriage rides, warm cider, festive performances, and more.
  • Score a discount on lodging when attending events at TD Garden through The Royal Sonesta Boston’s Events at the Garden package. Get a 10% discount on rooms, $1 parking, and an appetizer at Scull & Keel (a $15 value) by using the promo code GARDEN during booking and showing your event tickets upon check-in. 
  • Plan a discounted getaway in the White Mountains this winter at Cambria Hotel North Conway, which is taking 20% off two or more nights when travelers book by Nov. 30 for trips taken through March 31, 2027. Travelers must use the code LFPROM when booking.

I’ll leave you with this photo I took Saturday evening from Constantino’s Venda Bar & Ristorante in DePasquale Plaza.
